text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer is supposedly a tyrant of 
wicked cunning. Or so public opinion would 
have you believe.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fuhaha! What splendid entertainment! The 
sun rises from the depths of darkness! And 
it rises this summer!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This summer training camp will determine 
the success of my resurrection! Now, let 
us pen the opening chapter of a new 
chronicle of war!
